verdict.rationale: Twenty's no-code workflows include a native "Send email" action that can be chained with Delay, Branches and Iterator steps. Workflows can be triggered manually, on record changes or on schedules, so an ops user can approximate multi-step outbound emails from inside the CRM. However, nothing documents email templates, merge fields, or a dedicated sequence/cadence feature (enrollment, stop-on-reply, tracking), so sequences must be assembled by hand from generic workflow steps. Missing for 10: documented email templates with personalization, a purpose-built sequence feature, reply detection and engagement tracking, hands-on corroboration.
